title: Vectorless RAG knowledge assistant (Python)
summary: Cited answers over a document set with no vector database: a heading tree and SQLite FTS5 BM25, refusals, access control in SQL, guardrails against planted instructions, and a gate on 40 golden questions. A model is an optional switch.
verified: RUN: the 50 tests and the 40 golden questions ran here on Python 3.13 and 3.11 with the offline stub model: BM25 alone 35 of 40, with synonyms 39 of 40, tree navigation with synonyms 40 of 40, 0 safety violations. NOT RUN: the anthropic provider against the live API (no route to it from here); its request is tested with a fake transport.
stack_line: A vectorless retrieval-augmented assistant in Python 3.11+ (standard library; pypdf for PDF).
run_cmd: uv run -m vrag ask "How many days of annual leave do I get?"
